validation:is-true.doc:name: Valid source channel
validation:is-true.message: sourceChannel must be API_UPLOAD, API_JSON or FILE_DROP

validation:is-true.doc:name: Document fields present
validation:is-true.expression: #[vars.request.document != null and not isEmpty(vars.request.document.contentBase64 default '') and ((vars.request.document.sha256 default '') matches /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/)]
validation:is-true.message: document.fileName, mimeType, sizeBytes, sha256 (hex) and contentBase64 are required

db:select.doc:name: Find document by SHA-256
db:select.db:sql: SELECT d.invoice_id, i.status FROM invoice_documents d JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = d.invoice_id WHERE d.content_sha256 = :sha256

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { invoiceId: vars.existingDocs[0].invoice_id, status: vars.existingDocs[0].status, idempotentReplay: true }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert invoice
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_id, status, source_channel, submitted_by, correlation_id) VALUES (:invoiceId, 'RECEIVED', :sourceChannel, :submittedBy, :correlationId)

db:insert.doc:name: Insert document metadata
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO invoice_documents (invoice_id, file_name, mime_type, file_size_bytes, content_sha256, storage_path, uploaded_by) VALUES (:invoiceId, :fileName, :mimeType, :sizeBytes, :sha256, :storagePath, :uploadedBy)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, fileName: vars.request.document.fileName, mimeType: vars.request.document.mimeType, sizeBytes: vars.request.document.sizeBytes as Number, sha256: vars.request.document.sha256, storagePath: vars.storagePath, uploadedBy: vars.request.submittedBy }]

db:insert.doc:name: Audit: received
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processing_audit_logs (invoice_id, correlation_id, step, outcome, to_status, message, actor) VALUES (:invoiceId, :correlationId, 'RECEIVE', 'SUCCESS', 'RECEIVED', :message, :actor)

logger.doc:name: Log created
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { event: 'invoice.created', invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, channel: vars.request.sourceChannel }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, status: "RECEIVED", idempotentReplay: false }

db:select.doc:name: Select invoice
db:select.db:sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_number, normalized_invoice_number, vendor_id, extracted_vendor_id, extracted_vendor_name, po_number, DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS invoice_date, DATE_FORMAT(due_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS due_date, currency, billing_address, payment_terms, subtotal_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate, total_amount, status, approval_chain, approvals_required, approvals_received, extraction_provider, extraction_confidence, source_channel, CAST(validation_errors AS CHAR) AS validation_errors, CAST(exceptions AS CHAR) AS exceptions, duplicate_of, erp_document_number, DATE_FORMAT(erp_posted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS erp_posted_at, rejection_reason, submitted_by, correlation_id, version, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS updated_at FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId

set-variable.doc:name: 404 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 404, code: 'INVOICE_NOT_FOUND', message: 'Invoice ' ++ (vars.invoiceId default '') ++ ' not found' }]

db:select.doc:name: Select line items
db:select.db:sql: SELECT line_number, item_code, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, po_line_number, match_status FROM invoice_line_items WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId ORDER BY line_number

db:select.doc:name: Select approvals
db:select.db:sql: SELECT approval_level, decision, decided_by, decided_by_role, comments, DATE_FORMAT(decided_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS decided_at FROM approval_records WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId ORDER BY decided_at, approval_id

db:select.doc:name: Select document
db:select.db:sql: SELECT file_name, mime_type, file_size_bytes, content_sha256, storage_path, uploaded_by, DATE_FORMAT(uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS uploaded_at FROM invoice_documents WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var q = attributes.queryParams var size = (q.size default "20") as Number var page = (q.page default "1") as Number var maxSize = Mule::p('query.maxPageSize') as Number fun blankToNull(v) = if (v == null or isEmpty(v)) null else v --- { status: blankToNull(q.status), vendorId: blankToNull(q.vendorId), submittedBy: blankToNull(q.submittedBy), fromDate: blankToNull(q.fromDate), toDate: blankToNull(q.toDate), page: if (page < 1) 1 else page, size: if (size < 1) 1 else if (size > maxSize) maxSize else size }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM invoices WHERE (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) AND (:vendorId IS NULL OR vendor_id = :vendorId OR extracted_vendor_id = :vendorId) AND (:submittedBy IS NULL OR submitted_by = :submittedBy) AND (:fromDate IS NULL OR created_at >= :fromDate) AND (:toDate IS NULL OR created_at < DATE_ADD(:toDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))

db:select.doc:name: Select page
db:select.db:sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_number, COALESCE(vendor_id, extracted_vendor_id) AS vendor_id, extracted_vendor_name, po_number, DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS invoice_date, currency, total_amount, status, extraction_confidence, submitted_by, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') AS updated_at FROM invoices WHERE (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) AND (:vendorId IS NULL OR vendor_id = :vendorId OR extracted_vendor_id = :vendorId) AND (:submittedBy IS NULL OR submitted_by = :submittedBy) AND (:fromDate IS NULL OR created_at >= :fromDate) AND (:toDate IS NULL OR created_at < DATE_ADD(:toDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) ORDER BY created_at DESC, invoice_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var total = vars.countRows[0].total as Number --- { page: vars.filter.page, size: vars.filter.size, totalElements: total, totalPages: ceil(total / vars.filter.size), items: payload map ((r) -> { invoiceId: r.invoice_id, invoiceNumber: r.invoice_number, vendorId: r.vendor_id, vendorName: r.extracted_vendor_name, poNumber: r.po_number, invoiceDate: r.invoice_date, currency: r.currency, totalAmount: r.total_amount, status: r.status, extractionConfidence: r.extraction_confidence, submittedBy: r.submitted_by, createdAt: r.created_at, updatedAt: r.updated_at }) }

db:update.doc:name: Update invoice header
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE invoices SET invoice_number = :invoiceNumber, normalized_invoice_number = :normalizedInvoiceNumber, extracted_vendor_id = :vendorId, extracted_vendor_name = :vendorName, po_number = :poNumber, invoice_date = :invoiceDate, due_date = :dueDate, currency = :currency, billing_address = :billingAddress, payment_terms = :paymentTerms, subtotal_amount = :subtotal, tax_amount = :tax, tax_rate = :taxRate, total_amount = :total, extraction_provider = :provider, extraction_confidence = :confidence, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, invoiceNumber: vars.inv.invoiceNumber, normalizedInvoiceNumber: vars.inv.normalizedInvoiceNumber, vendorId: vars.inv.vendor.id, vendorName: vars.inv.vendor.name, poNumber: vars.inv.poNumber, invoiceDate: vars.inv.invoiceDate, dueDate: vars.inv.dueDate, currency: vars.inv.currency, billingAddress: vars.inv.billingAddress, paymentTerms: vars.inv.paymentTerms, subtotal: vars.inv.subtotal, tax: vars.inv.tax, taxRate: vars.inv.taxRate, total: vars.inv.total, provider: vars.inv.extraction.provider, confidence: vars.inv.extraction.overallConfidence }]

set-variable.doc:name: 404 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 404, code: 'INVOICE_NOT_FOUND', message: 'Invoice ' ++ vars.invoiceId ++ ' not found' }]

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Bulk insert line items
db:bulk-insert.db:bulk-input-parameters: #[(vars.inv.lineItems default []) map ((li) -> { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, lineNumber: li.lineNumber, itemCode: li.itemCode, description: li.description, quantity: li.quantity, unitPrice: li.unitPrice, amount: li.amount })]
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO invoice_line_items (invoice_id, line_number, item_code, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount) VALUES (:invoiceId, :lineNumber, :itemCode, :description, :quantity, :unitPrice, :amount)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, saved: true, lineItems: sizeOf(vars.inv.lineItems default []) }

db:select.doc:name: Current status
db:select.db:sql: SELECT status, version FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId

set-variable.doc:name: 404 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 404, code: 'INVOICE_NOT_FOUND', message: 'Invoice ' ++ vars.invoiceId ++ ' not found' }]

db:update.doc:name: Update status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE invoices SET status = :status, vendor_id = COALESCE(:vendorId, vendor_id), approval_chain = COALESCE(:approvalChain, approval_chain), approvals_required = COALESCE(:approvalsRequired, approvals_required), approvals_received = COALESCE(:approvalsReceived, approvals_received), validation_errors = COALESCE(:validationErrors, validation_errors), exceptions = COALESCE(:exceptions, exceptions), duplicate_of = COALESCE(:duplicateOf, duplicate_of), erp_document_number = COALESCE(:erpDocumentNumber, erp_document_number), erp_posted_at = COALESCE(:erpPostedAt, erp_posted_at), rejection_reason = COALESCE(:rejectionReason, rejection_reason), version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId AND (:expectedStatus IS NULL OR status = :expectedStatus) AND (:expectedVersion IS NULL OR version = :expectedVersion)
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 var f = vars.change.fields default {} fun jsonOrNull(v) = if (v == null) null else write(v, "application/json", { indent: false }) fun toDbTimestamp(t) = if (t == null) null else ((t as DateTime) >> "UTC") as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" } --- { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, status: vars.change.status, expectedStatus: vars.change.expectedStatus, expectedVersion: vars.change.expectedVersion, vendorId: f.vendorId, approvalChain: if (f.approvalChain is Array) (f.approvalChain joinBy ",") else f.approvalChain, approvalsRequired: f.approvalsRequired, approvalsReceived: f.approvalsReceived, validationErrors: jsonOrNull(f.validationErrors), exceptions: jsonOrNull(f.exceptions), duplicateOf: f.duplicateOf, erpDocumentNumber: f.erpDocumentNumber, erpPostedAt: toDbTimestamp(f.erpPostedAt), rejectionReason: f.rejectionReason }]

set-variable.doc:name: 409 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 409, code: 'STALE_UPDATE', message: 'Invoice is ' ++ vars.current[0].status ++ ' (version ' ++ (vars.current[0].version as String) ++ '); expected ' ++ (vars.change.expectedStatus default '*') ++ ' / version ' ++ ((vars.change.expectedVersion default '*') as String) }]

db:update.doc:name: Update line match
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE invoice_line_items SET po_line_number = :poLine, match_status = :status WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId AND line_number = :invoiceLine
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, invoiceLine: payload.invoiceLine, poLine: payload.poLine, status: payload.status }]

db:insert.doc:name: Audit status change
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processing_audit_logs (invoice_id, correlation_id, step, outcome, from_status, to_status, message, actor, details) VALUES (:invoiceId, :correlationId, :step, :outcome, :fromStatus, :toStatus, :message, :actor, :details)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, correlationId: correlationId, step: vars.change.step default 'STATUS_CHANGE', outcome: vars.change.outcome default 'SUCCESS', fromStatus: vars.current[0].status, toStatus: vars.change.status, message: do { var m = (vars.change.reason default ('Status changed to ' ++ vars.change.status)) as String --- if (sizeOf(m) > 1000) m[0 to 999] else m }, actor: vars.change.actor default 'system', details: if (vars.change.details == null) null else write(vars.change.details, 'application/json', { indent: false }) }]

logger.doc:name: Log status change
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { event: 'invoice.status.changed', invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, from: vars.current[0].status, to: vars.change.status }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, previousStatus: vars.current[0].status, status: vars.change.status, version: (vars.current[0].version as Number) + 1 }

validation:is-true.doc:name: vendorId and normalizedInvoiceNumber required
validation:is-true.message: vendorId and normalizedInvoiceNumber query parameters are required

set-variable.doc:name: Query params
set-variable.value: #[{ vendorId: attributes.queryParams.vendorId, normalized: upper(attributes.queryParams.normalizedInvoiceNumber), total: if (isEmpty(attributes.queryParams.totalAmount default '')) null else attributes.queryParams.totalAmount as Number, invoiceDate: if (isEmpty(attributes.queryParams.invoiceDate default '')) null else attributes.queryParams.invoiceDate, exclude: attributes.queryParams.excludeInvoiceId default '', windowDays: Mule::p('query.duplicateDateWindowDays') as Number }]

db:select.doc:name: Exact matches
db:select.db:sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_number, status, total_amount, DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS invoice_date FROM invoices WHERE (vendor_id = :vendorId OR extracted_vendor_id = :vendorId) AND normalized_invoice_number = :normalized AND invoice_id <> :exclude AND status NOT IN ('DUPLICATE','REJECTED','VALIDATION_FAILED','FAILED')

db:select.doc:name: Possible matches
db:select.db:sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_number, status, total_amount, DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS invoice_date FROM invoices WHERE (vendor_id = :vendorId OR extracted_vendor_id = :vendorId) AND :total IS NOT NULL AND :invoiceDate IS NOT NULL AND total_amount = :total AND invoice_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(:invoiceDate, INTERVAL :windowDays DAY) AND DATE_ADD(:invoiceDate, INTERVAL :windowDays DAY) AND COALESCE(normalized_invoice_number, '') <> :normalized AND invoice_id <> :exclude AND status NOT IN ('DUPLICATE','REJECTED','VALIDATION_FAILED','FAILED') LIMIT 10

db:select.doc:name: Select document
db:select.db:sql: SELECT file_name, mime_type, file_size_bytes, content_sha256, storage_path FROM invoice_documents WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId

set-variable.doc:name: 404 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 404, code: 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No document stored for this invoice' }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import toBase64 from dw::core::Binaries --- { fileName: vars.docs[0].file_name, mimeType: vars.docs[0].mime_type, sizeBytes: vars.docs[0].file_size_bytes, sha256: vars.docs[0].content_sha256, contentBase64: toBase64(payload as Binary) }

db:select.doc:name: Select audit trail
db:select.db:sql: SELECT audit_id, correlation_id, step, outcome, from_status, to_status, message, actor, CAST(details AS CHAR) AS details, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%T.%fZ') AS created_at FROM processing_audit_logs WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId ORDER BY created_at, audit_id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { invoiceId: attributes.uriParams.invoiceId, events: payload map ((r) -> { auditId: r.audit_id, timestamp: r.created_at, step: r.step, outcome: r.outcome, fromStatus: r.from_status, toStatus: r.to_status, message: r.message, actor: r.actor, correlationId: r.correlation_id, details: if (r.details == null) null else read(r.details, "application/json") }) }

validation:is-true.doc:name: Valid outcome
validation:is-true.message: outcome must be STARTED, SUCCESS, FAILED, WARNING or INFO

db:insert.doc:name: Insert audit record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processing_audit_logs (invoice_id, correlation_id, step, outcome, message, actor, details) VALUES (:invoiceId, :correlationId, :step, :outcome, :message, :actor, :details)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: attributes.uriParams.invoiceId, correlationId: correlationId, step: do { var st = (payload.step default 'NOTE') as String --- if (sizeOf(st) > 50) st[0 to 49] else st }, outcome: payload.outcome, message: payload.message, actor: payload.actor default 'system', details: if (payload.details == null) null else write(payload.details, 'application/json', { indent: false }) }]

validation:is-true.doc:name: Valid decision
validation:is-true.message: decision must be APPROVED or REJECTED

db:insert.doc:name: Insert approval record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO approval_records (invoice_id, approval_level, decision, decided_by, decided_by_role, comments) VALUES (:invoiceId, :approvalLevel, :decision, :decidedBy, :decidedByRole, :comments)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: attributes.uriParams.invoiceId, approvalLevel: payload.approvalLevel, decision: payload.decision, decidedBy: payload.decidedBy, decidedByRole: payload.decidedByRole, comments: payload.comments }]
